note: Embedded（src/core/tools/edit/Edit.ts）与 Standalone（core-rs/src/tools.rs run_edit）的 Edit 工具结果对照表。TS 侧测试断言本表等于 EditTool 的真实输出；Rust 侧测试断言 run_edit 的结果等于本表。error 为工具抛出的原始错误文案（Rust 侧 ToolOutcome::Error 的文本）。

cases.name: single-line-partial
cases.why: 整行变化：1 增 1 删

Made 1 replacement
Edited line 1

Lines: 4 (+1, -1)

cases.name: not-found
cases.why: 找不到 old_string 的错误文案
cases.error:
The specified old_string was not found in the file. Please read the file first and use the exact text.
Note: Read output uses | as separator between line number and content. Make sure NOT to include the line number and the separator | in old_string.

cases.name: ambiguous
cases.why: 多处匹配且未 replace_all 的错误文案
cases.error: The old_string matches 2 locations within the search range. When replace_all is false, old_string must match exactly once. Please include more surrounding context to make old_string unique, or set replace_all to true.

cases.name: replace-all-string-true
cases.why: replace_all 传字符串 "true" 也要全量替换
cases.expected:
Edited file: a.txt
Made 2 replacements
Edited line 1
Lines: 3 (+2, -2)

cases.name: replace-all-string-false
cases.why: replace_all 传字符串 "false" 不得全量替换（应报多处匹配）
cases.error: The old_string matches 2 locations within the search range. When replace_all is false, old_string must match exactly once. Please include more surrounding context to make old_string unique, or set replace_all to true.
